notes.en: Commentary: this line exists only when the game-start roll gave the 'empty cluster' outcome (none of gray_goo_crisis_set / dragon_season / gray_goo_empire_set): anomaly disco_gray_cat spawns only on gray-goo planets of the L-Cluster, and graygoo.550 fires only in that case on first entering an L-Cluster system (common/anomalies/95_anomaly_categories_distant_stars.txt:1713-1735; events/gray_goo_events.txt:2889-2910).
